messages:
zoe: HEADS UP — AcmeCorp escalation: their traces for request_id abc123XYZ are showing up in logs but Trace View returns "No spans found" when clicking link. Customer provided request IDs and sample trace links. I'm attaching repro steps.
support-bot: Ticket created: RC-4922. Severity: P1 (customer-facing).
matt: Can you paste the raw request_id from their logs and a trace link?
zoe: request_id=abc123XYZ, log snippet:
```
INFO 2025-06-11 Request received id=abc123XYZ path=/v1/generate
```
Trace link: https://console.redwood.ai/traces?trace_id=tr_7f4b... returns empty view.
anita: I'm seeing a pattern — our trace linker expects request_id to be normalized lowercase. If the customer sends mixed-case request IDs we don't match. Likely regression after the header sanitizer change last week.
matt: repro steps from my side:
1) curl -H "X-Request-Id: abc123XYZ" -d '{...}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1
2) check logs: request_id preserved
3) console trace search: no results
Snippet to reproduce:
```
curl -i -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-Id: abc123XYZ" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
eng-runtime: assigning to eng-runtime @michael. Early debug: linker service lowercases request_id during ingestion pipeline but the tracer upstream stores as-is -> mismatch. Log from linker:
```
ERROR linker: failed to map request_id "abc123XYZ" -> normalized: "abc123xyz" no mapping
```
Also seeing temporary Kafka lag (stall on partition 4) but that's unrelated.
michael: Confirmed. Root cause: sanitizer change (PR #4123) introduced ToLower on ingestion path but tracing export kept original case. Plan: quick fix to canonicalize on lookup side and add compatibility flag. I'll push hotfix to sandbox and then prod canary.
zoe: Customer wants workaround ASAP. Any interim fix?
anita: Workaround for support: in Console -> Traces, use search filter `request_id:"abc123XYZ" OR request_id:"abc123xyz"`. Also can search by request path and timeframe. I've sent instructions to the customer. :thumbsup:
matt: Created internal ticket ENG-1137 for the fix, linked to RC-4922, tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. ETA for prod rollout ~36-48h. I'll update RC-4922 and ping the customer.
zoe: thanks. Marking as escalated. Will follow up with customer after patch. cc @eng-sre
